steps.step: positive: two eligible offers, lowest eligible price selected under the visible policy, budget reserved
negative: two eligible offers, lowest eligible price selected under the visible policy, budget reserved
positive: executed by the provider, verified in a separate worker process, accepted with the same complete amount
negative: executed by the provider, verified in a separate worker process, accepted with the same complete amount
positive: exact payment observed on the private local chain and reconciled
negative: exact payment observed on the private local chain and reconciled
positive: the declared 10 % fee is a separate entitlement paid by the requester to the treasury address and observed on the rail
negative: the declared 10 % fee is a separate entitlement paid by the requester to the treasury address and observed on the rail
provider received both agreed payments in full; the treasury address received the two fees; the payer funded both
fabricated positive: another contract's FEASIBLE artifact presented against the negative contract is rejected (contract digest / input root binding)
solver timeout presented as infeasible: execution failed, science no_valid_evidence, nothing payable
duplicate claim with a new request salt: refused; one entitlement, already paid, no second payment identity
dispute against a mistaken rejection: superseding acceptance from preserved replay evidence; the original decision retained
fee-backed treasury award: confirmed fee revenue funds a bounded award that pays an accepted negative from the treasury account
journal replay consistent, invariants hold, identity/protocol files and base issuance untouched
offline verifier on the full bundle: replays the INFEASIBLE determination
steps.verdict: structurally valid, signatures trusted, scientific scope replayed

steps.step: offline verifier on the restricted bundle: reports the missing private evidence honestly
steps.verdict: structurally valid, signatures trusted, scientific scope limited

what_this_shows: a verified INFEASIBLE determination is accepted and paid exactly like the verified FEASIBLE one under the frozen outcome-neutral policy
fabricated positives, mislabeled timeouts and duplicate claims are refused or left unresolved without a second payment
a mistaken rejection is corrected through an authorized dispute using preserved replay evidence, never by editing the original decision
fees observed on the local chain fund a bounded treasury award; the journal conserves every amount; base issuance and protocol files are untouched
what_this_does_not_show: price discovery or independent organizations (one operator plays every role on one host)
public settlement (private in-memory py-evm chain, synthetic accounts)
